program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[list(row) for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr=[r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1]
    vc=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
    # Uniform full lines are the panel dividers. Keep them unchanged.
    rb=[-1]+hr+[h]
    cb=[-1]+vc+[w]
    rparts=[(rb[i]+1,rb[i+1]) for i in range(len(rb)-1) if rb[i]+1<rb[i+1]]
    cparts=[(cb[i]+1,cb[i+1]) for i in range(len(cb)-1) if cb[i]+1<cb[i+1]]
    if len(rparts)*len(cparts)<=1:
        return g
    panels=[]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rparts):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cparts):
            tile=[row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]]
            score=sum(v!=bg for row in tile for v in row)
            panels.append((score,ri,ci,tile))
    _,_,_,src=max(panels,key=lambda x:x[0])
    th,tw=len(src),len(src[0])
    for r0,r1 in rparts:
        for c0,c1 in cparts:
            if r1-r0==th and c1-c0==tw:
                for i in range(th):
                    g[r0+i][c0:c1]=src[i][:]
    return g
'''
